# Kubera AI Full AI Search Context

## Company

Kubera AI is an automation company focused on digital workforce systems for companies that run on repeatable business processes. The positioning line is: Living Systems. Smart Automation.

Kubera AI builds systems for businesses that want automation without losing control and growth without operational chaos.

## Core Services

- Customer Communications: chat agents, newsletters, lead processing 24/7.
- Sales & Leads: lead qualification, follow-up, CRM integration.
- Internal Processes: reporting, approvals, routine automation.
- HR & Hiring: resume screening, onboarding, internal HR bot.
- Content & Marketing: auto-generated posts, publishing, brand monitoring.
- Finance & Documents: invoice processing, financial reports, AR control.
- E-commerce & Logistics: order notifications, returns, request handling.
- Education & Online Schools: student support, materials delivery, payment reminders.
- Real Estate & Rentals: request handling, tenant qualification, reminders.
- Hotels & Restaurants: booking, guest notifications, feedback collection.
- Transport & Logistics: delivery notifications, route sheets.
- Beauty & Health: client booking, reminders, post-visit feedback.
- Medical Clinics & Dental: patient booking, visit reminders, feedback collection.
- Auto Business & Car Rentals: service booking, car reservations, client base management.
- Landing Page GPT-NTI: Landing + WhatsApp / Telegram + CRM + Lead Automation.

## How Kubera AI Works

1. Diagnosis: analyze the business process, where leads are lost, where time is wasted, and where automation delivers value.
2. Solution Architecture: design the system before implementation.
3. Development & Setup: build integrations, logic, testing, and automation flows.
4. Launch & Testing: validate on real workflows and hand over with documentation.
5. Ongoing Support: monitor, fix issues, and improve systems as the business grows.

## AI Assistant Roadmap

The site has a reserved AI Assistant layer. Future implementation should keep model calls behind server-side routes, avoid exposing API keys in frontend code, include rate limiting, logging, abuse controls, and support safe handoff to n8n/email/CRM workflows.

## Automation Integration Notes

Future form processing architecture is: frontend form -> backend API route -> n8n webhook/email/CRM. Webhook URLs and API keys must not be exposed in browser code.
